Split by the 18.0 QA wave dispatch session `session_01CfRDy7SuTfUqaTu2AEH2Hi`, on the maintainer's instruction there, verbatim: 「#13115 你可以拆」.

## Where

The bell → the Inbox header.

## Actual

"4 total · 1 notifications + 3 pending approvals", while the one group row under it reads "×3 · 3 unread".

## Expected

The singular for one ("1 notification"); the plural forms exist for `approvalsPending` but not for this key.

## Source

`packages/i18n/src/locales/en.ts` — `inbox.badgeNotifications: '{{unread}} notifications'` has no `_one` / `_other` forms (the variable is not `count`, so i18next pluralization never runs).
